visibleEditorialCopy.description: After moving to a small French village, Elle strikes up a romance with Pin-Pon, an infatuated local mechanic. But beneath the summer heat, she harbors a calculating, personal motive of her own.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A steady, emotionally heavy French crime drama fueled by quiet obsession and simmering suspense, best absorbed in focused solo viewing.
